question: Can a spatially modulated edge law by itself select the seven-cell harmonic port under C3 symmetry?

objects.normalization: M columns have norm sqrt(2),sqrt(6); quotient-independent

uniform, local impulse or signed zero-mean spatial pattern
objects.normalization: uniform a,b each divided by sqrt(N); integer toy source raw

calculation_steps: Expand F_a=M^T W B1^T x with oriented A-to-B edge incidence and h_t/sqrt(N).
For normalized uniform x, factor (b-a)/sqrt(N) and average N edges per direction to obtain (b-a) sum_t h_t bar w_t.
C3 cyclically permutes direction edge sets, implying equal means; since sum_t h_t=0, F=0 for every N.
For an A-site delta, collapse to three local weights and obtain -sum_t h_t w_t(r0)/sqrt(N); B-site analogous.
Expand x and w in finite characters chi_k; sum over r yields delta_(p+k,0 mod N) and the exact Fourier cross-spectrum formula.
Replay positive rational spatial weights, uniform and impulse inputs, and aligned/displaced signed zero-mean source at N=7,13,19.
Construct target-informed character labels p=2,k=5: zero-sector overlap iff N divides 7; works at N=7 and fails at 13/19, without a common physical wavelength law.

result.exact_expression: F_a=(b-a) sum_t h_t bar w_t for uniform normalized x; F_a=sqrt(N) sum_(t,k) h_t hat w_t(-k)[exp(-2pi i k s_t/N)hat x_B(k)-hat x_A(k)] for arbitrary x
result.units: internal response times internal vertex source, unspecified physical units
result.precision_and_error: exact finite identities and integer/Fraction replay; no floating approximation
result.scope: diagonal registry response on periodic honeycomb, incidence-gradient vertex input, unit metric; C3 conclusion assumes full direction-permuting symmetry
result.physical_interpretation: No force or load prediction; material law, drive spectrum and loss remain OPEN

verification.method: symbolic finite-character orthogonality and C3 orbit argument

counterexamples_and_failures: Spatially unequal weights with equal three direction means cancel uniform input on all tested quotients.
A local site impulse remains nonzero with amplitude 1/sqrt(N) but does not intrinsically prefer seven cells.
An aligned zero-mean source activates the same positive-weight perturbation that a disjoint source does not; source preparation matters.
Engineered p+k=7 matches seven cells, but labels defined as characters of each quotient rescale their physical wavelength; this is not an independent prediction.
limitations: C3 covariance of the full quotient is an explicit symmetry assumption; a contact or strain can break it.
No graphite-specific edge stiffness, source generation, damping or kinetic friction map is imported.
Fourier mode matching is a necessary algebraic overlap, not a positive friction or load-slope theorem.
The observed paired angles were known before model construction; toy arrays are target-informed illustrations.
changed_dependencies: Refines prior locality README loophole: registry modulation cannot evade uniform-source C3 cancellation by itself.
